packet_name: Blinded operator-classification packet for Paper VII empirical cohort
purpose: Independent operator classification of the 25 empirical curve-fit domains without access to operator_class, predicted_family, or model-name hints.

domains.blind_name: Mammalian basal metabolism vs body size
domains.system_description: Basal metabolic rate measured across mammalian species as a function of body mass.
domains.source: Kleiber (1932), reproduced in Dodds et al. (2001)
domains.notes: Original 13-point mammal dataset; BMR converted to watts.
domains.instructions: Classify the operator class as multiplicative, additive, or bounded from the physical/system mechanism only. Do not infer from expected curve shape alone.
